_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per curated-snapshot-format.md §2.3 (task T032). mfm_slug and detail_source_faction_id are CURATED-ONLY provenance keys, dropped at the bundle boundary. parent_faction_id carries the points source's chapter split (C3/R6); the consuming app must include ancestors when querying a faction (reference-db-schema.md §3.5).
title: Curated factions.json

army_rule_state.description: 004 FR-021. 'none' = the faction genuinely has no army rule. OMITTED = not yet curated. Expressing the third state by absence is what makes the distinction between 'no army rule' and 'nobody has looked yet' available to a consumer at all; a two-valued field would show the same empty section for both.

provenance.description: Carried by every curated entity, not only disputed ones (FR-003). is_hybrid_edition is derived (detail_edition_code != points_edition_code) and never stored.
